text: No, the analysis did not detect any tree-cover loss event on the property after 2020. The assessment status is "NOT_DETECTED," meaning no significant tree-cover loss (0.5 ha or larger) occurred between 2021 and 2025. The data sources used (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) confirm this, with full spatial coverage and annual observations up to 2025. The asset retained over 91% of its forest cover as of 2020, and no detectable changes were observed afterward.
